name: Krusch-Git MCP
description: Read-only Git DAG indexer, AST symbol search, blast-radius dependency graph, and hybrid BM25 + pgvector semantic code retrieval for coding agents. Read-only tools inherit Guard policy; unknown tools require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use krusch_git_search_symbols, krusch_git_file_symbols, and krusch_git_dependency_graph to inspect signatures and call graphs before reading full blobs.
Use search_type='keyword' on krusch_git_semantic_search to query PostgreSQL full-text indices without sending query text to the embedding endpoint.
Point DATABASE_URL at a read-only PostgreSQL role when running the stdio MCP server, since all seven MCP tools only query indexed repositories.
